cards.name: Ada Lovelace
cards.fact: Wrote the first published algorithm for a machine, a century before any computer existed.

cards.name: Alan Turing
cards.fact: Described a universal machine on paper. Every computer since is one of them.

cards.name: Grace Hopper
cards.fact: Built the first compiler, so programs could be written in words instead of numbers.

cards.name: Katherine Johnson
cards.fact: Checked the orbit for John Glenn's flight by hand. He would not launch until she had.

cards.name: Claude Shannon
cards.fact: Showed that all information can be measured in bits. He named the unit too.

cards.name: Hedy Lamarr
cards.fact: Co-invented frequency hopping, the idea behind Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and GPS.

cards.name: Margaret Hamilton
cards.fact: Led the Apollo flight software. Her error handling kept the Moon landing on track.

cards.name: Tim Berners-Lee
cards.fact: Proposed the World Wide Web at CERN, then gave it to everyone for free.

cards.name: Radia Perlman
cards.fact: Invented the spanning tree protocol that stops networks looping. She wrote it as a poem.
